triaged_non_blocking.triage_note: Not a code defect. On this QA site, the 'business' listing type's allowed_categories term meta (_listora_allowed_categories on the listora_listing_type term) was an empty array, so GET /listora/v1/listing-types/business/categories returned [] and the submission wizard's Category dropdown on the Basic Information step had nothing but 'Select a category' for Business listings -- even though 116 listora_listing_cat terms exist site-wide and every other listing type (restaurant, hotel, real-estate, event, place) returned populated category lists from the same endpoint. Verified the type-scoped filtering code (Listing_Type::get_allowed_categories()) works correctly for every other type, so this is a content/config gap specific to this QA site's Business type (most likely leftover from earlier ad hoc testing that never re-seeded Business categories), not a plugin bug. Temporarily seeded one category + patched allowed_categories to unblock the mandatory D.string-shaped-field-options-fatal journey walk, then reverted both to the original empty state afterward so the site ends in the state it was found.
triaged_non_blocking.expected: Business listing type has at least one seeded category so the required Category field on the submission wizard is selectable end-to-end for a real customer.
triaged_non_blocking.actual: GET /wp-json/listora/v1/listing-types/business/categories returned [] before this run; restored to that same empty state after verification.
triaged_non_blocking.opus_verification: Re-verified by the calling session 2026-08-04: GET /listing-types/business/categories returns [] while /listing-types/restaurant/categories returns 15 from the identical code path, and _listora_allowed_categories term meta for the business term is an empty array with 116 listora_listing_cat terms present site-wide. Environment data state on this QA install, not a plugin defect - does not block 1.4.1. Filed as a Suggestion card (empty-category admin nudge) instead of Bugs.
